title: Pure Gate Guardian
summary: Pure Gate Guardian build combining Sanga of the Thunder, Kazejin, and Suijin with the Labyrinth support that places them face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone. Because the Gate Guardian Fusions banish their named materials from anywhere on your field, brothers placed as Continuous Spells count as live Fusion Material.

summary.title: Starters
points: Labyrinth Heavy Tank Normal Summons without Tributing, places Sanga of the Thunder, Kazejin, or Suijin from your hand, Deck, or banishment face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, and destroys an opponent's monster if you control a Labyrinth Wall card.

Shadow Ghoul of the Labyrinth discards itself to search Labyrinth Wall Shadow from the Deck, and banishes itself from the GY when the opponent battles while you control a Labyrinth Wall card to destroy an opponent's monster.
Labyrinth Wall Shadow places one of the three brothers from your hand, Deck, or banishment into your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell every Main Phase.

summary.title: Opening: Shadow Ghoul + Labyrinth Heavy Tank
steps: Discard Shadow Ghoul of the Labyrinth to search Labyrinth Wall Shadow, activate it, and use its Main Phase effect to place Sanga of the Thunder (or Kazejin/Suijin) in your Spell & Trap Zone.
Normal Summon Labyrinth Heavy Tank without Tributing and place a second brother in your Spell & Trap Zone (destroying an opponent's monster if going second).

Contact Fuse the two brothers from your Spell & Trap Zone into Gate Guardian of Thunder and Wind to search Double Attack! Wind and Thunder!! or Dark Element, or into Gate Guardian of Wind and Water for two Spell/Trap negates.
With a third brother in the hand, field, or GY, banish all three to Special Summon Gate Guardians Combined.

summary.title: Bosses & Control: The Gate Guardian Fusions
points: Gate Guardians Combined (3750 ATK) banishes Sanga, Kazejin, and Suijin from your hand, field, and/or GY to Special Summon itself, negates and destroys effects that target cards you control up to 3 times per turn, and floats into a Level 11 or lower Gate Guardian from your Extra Deck when it leaves the field because of an opponent's card.
Gate Guardian of Wind and Water (Kazejin + Suijin) negates a Spell or Trap effect on the field up to twice per turn.
Gate Guardian of Water and Thunder (Suijin + Sanga) zeroes the ATK of a face-up monster the opponent controls up to twice per turn.

Gate Guardian of Thunder and Wind (Sanga + Kazejin) searches any Spell or Trap that mentions all three brothers during your Main Phase; all three two-piece Fusions float into one of their banished materials when destroyed.

summary.title: Dark Element & GY Recursion
points: Dark Element activates when a Gate Guardian monster is in your GY, paying half your LP to Special Summon a Level 11 or higher Gate Guardian monster (Gate Guardians Combined, Dark Guardian, or the original Gate Guardian) from your hand, Deck, or Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions.
Dark Guardian (3800 ATK) cannot be destroyed by battle and is unaffected by other monsters' effects and Trap effects when summoned by Dark Element.

Double Attack! Wind and Thunder!! (destroys a card while you control a Gate Guardian), Riryoku Guardian (halves the opponent's LP and adds that amount to your Gate Guardian's ATK), and Prey of the Jirai Gumo (Trap Monster that destroys a monster in its column) can each banish themselves from the GY to add a banished Sanga, Kazejin, or Suijin to your hand.
